title.rendered: ‘He Was Wrongly Jailed at 14′ — Sister Fights to Free Imprisoned Brother

content.rendered:
A sister, Oluwatomisin Adekunle is calling for help to free her 14-year-old brother, whom she says was wrongly jailed and since been remanded in Kirikiri after being arrested while trying to earn a living on the streets. According to her, the teenager was picked up during a police operation and taken into custody despite being underage, a situation that has left their family devastated and searching for answers.

In an emotional appeal, she urged authorities and concerned Nigerians to intervene, insisting that her brother deserves a chance to return home and continue his life.
